source.name: OpenRouter Data API
source.terms: Aggregated public data. Not to be re-served as a competing free API. Figures may be restated as snapshots refresh, so each block keeps the meta block it was published with.
source.attribution: Source: OpenRouter (openrouter.ai/rankings), as of 2026-11-23T02:56:32.003Z. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

tokens30d.attribution: Source: OpenRouter (openrouter.ai/rankings), as of 2026-11-23T02:56:32.003Z. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
tokens30d.what: Tokens (prompt and completion) per model over the period, summed from the daily top 50 public models. The share is of all public tokens, the `other` row included.

tasks7d.attribution: Source: OpenRouter (openrouter.ai/rankings), as of 2026-11-22. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
tasks7d.what: Each task tag's share of classified requests over the trailing 7 days, and its top models by share of that tag's requests. Sampled; no absolute volumes. A route with no model id is not in the model list.
